Package com.robojacks.lib.kinematics

Class TrackingWheelOdometry

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.kinematics.TrackingWheelOdometry
public class TrackingWheelOdometry extends Object
Odometry from unpowered tracking wheels (on Rotation Sensors or 3-wire encoders) plus the Inertial Sensor for heading. Tracking wheels don't slip when the drive pushes or spins its wheels, so they stay accurate where drive-encoder odometry drifts. This is the standard setup for competitive VEX autonomous.

Typical layout: one wheel that rolls forward/back (forward) and one that rolls sideways (sideways). Each wheel's location relative to the robot's center corrects for the motion it sees when the robot spins in place. Locations use WPILib's robot coordinate system, like swerve module locations: +X toward the robot's front, +Y to its left, meters. 


 // Forward wheel 1.5" left of center; sideways wheel 3" behind center
 Translation2d kForwardWheelLocation = new Translation2d(0.0, Units.inchesToMeters(1.5));
 Translation2d kSidewaysWheelLocation = new Translation2d(Units.inchesToMeters(-3.0), 0.0);

 TrackingWheelOdometry m_odometry = new TrackingWheelOdometry(
         kForwardWheelLocation, kSidewaysWheelLocation,
         m_gyro.getRotation2d(), m_forwardWheel.getPosition(), m_sidewaysWheel.getPosition());

 // in periodic():
 m_odometry.update(m_gyro.getRotation2d(), m_forwardWheel.getPosition(), m_sidewaysWheel.getPosition());

No sideways wheel? Pass 0 for its distance every time. The robot is then assumed not to slide sideways, which is true for most tank drives unless they're pushed.

    • TrackingWheelOdometry

      public TrackingWheelOdometry(double forwardWheelLeftOffset, double sidewaysWheelForwardOffset, Rotation2d gyroAngle, double forwardDistance, double sidewaysDistance, Pose2d initialPose)
      Parameters:
      forwardWheelLeftOffset - meters the forward-rolling wheel is LEFT of the turning center (negative = right of center)
      sidewaysWheelForwardOffset - meters the sideways-rolling wheel is IN FRONT of the turning center (negative = behind)
      gyroAngle - current heading, counter-clockwise positive
      forwardDistance - forward wheel's travel so far, meters (positive = robot moving forward)
      sidewaysDistance - sideways wheel's travel so far, meters (positive = robot moving left)
      initialPose - where the robot starts

    • TrackingWheelOdometry

      public TrackingWheelOdometry(Translation2d forwardWheelLocation, Translation2d sidewaysWheelLocation, Rotation2d gyroAngle, double forwardDistance, double sidewaysDistance, Pose2d initialPose)
      Parameters:
      forwardWheelLocation - where the forward-rolling wheel touches the floor, from the robot's center (+X forward, +Y left). Only its Y (left-right) matters.
      sidewaysWheelLocation - where the sideways-rolling wheel touches the floor. Only its X (front-back) matters.
